title: Mao (manga) — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
What culture calls destiny in Mao (manga) is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. Mao (stylized in all caps) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Rumiko Takahashi. It has been serialized in Shogakukan's Weekly Shōnen Sunday magazine since May 2019, with its chapters collected in 31 tankōbon volumes as of October 2026.

The bleak reading of Mao (manga) is also the most testable one. He uses his powers to cause droughts in villages, then offering his services to summon rain for a price. Supposedly a distant descendant of a Goko clan member, he joins forces with Shiranui after meeting Mei.
